answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit jade bond and registers one forge stamping outputs with a pulse log. A beacon draws three peer auditors each epoch to re-run one sampled forge job and verify its pulse log. A copied pulse log or faked output burns the bond. Fees rise per identity: first 41, k-th 41+6(k-1), the 1,000th 6,035; 1,000 fakes pay 3,038,000 plus 70,000 in bonds. Rubber-stamp auditors lose their own jade bond. An honest agent pays 41 once.
